mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MATE_COMMENT ( mate_id, user_id, content, status ) VALUES ( #{mateId}, #{userId}, #{content}, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.mate_id AS mateId, c.user_id AS userId, c.content AS content, c.status AS status, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, u.nickname AS nickname, u.profile_img AS profileImg FROM TB_MATE_COMMENT c JOIN TB_USER u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.mate_id = #{mateId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MATE_COMMENT WHERE mate_id = #{mateId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT comment_id AS commentId, mate_id AS mateId, user_id AS userId, content, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM TB_MATE_COMMENT WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MATE_COMMENT SET content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE TB_MATE_COMMENT SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
